title: NBA: Jokic, Murray help Nuggets hand Pelicans 6th straight loss

blocks.text: NEW ORLEANS — Nikola Jokic had 26 points, eight rebounds and 10 assists, Jamal Murray added 23 points, seven rebounds and nine assists, and the Denver Nuggets outlasted the New Orleans Pelicans 116-108 in the NBA on Saturday night. Denver has won four of its last five games and moved to 3-0 against the Pelicans this season. New Orleans dropped its sixth consecutive contest, four of which have come at home.
